blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In this work we present a novel method for the challenging problem of depth image upsampling. Modern depth cameras such as Kinect or Time of Flight cameras deliver dense, high quality depth measurements but are limited in their lateral resolution. To overcome this limitation we formulate a convex optimization problem using higher order regularization for depth image upsampling. In this optimization an anisotropic diffusion tensor, calculated from a high resolution intensity image, is used to guide the upsampling. We derive a numerical algorithm based on a primaldual formulation that is efficiently parallelized and runs at multiple frames per second. We show that this novel upsampling clearly outperforms state of the art approaches in terms of speed and accuracy on the widely used Middlebury 2007 datasets. Furthermore, we introduce novel datasets with highly accurate groundtruth, which, for the first time, enable to benchmark depth upsampling methods using real sensor data.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出了一种解决深度图像取景这一具有挑战性的问题的新方法。 Kinect或飞行时空相机等现代深度相机提供密度高,质量高的深度测量,但其横向分辨率有限. 为了克服这一限制,我们用更高的定序规范来进行深度图像上取样,从而形成一个对流优化问题。 在这种优化中,用从高分辨率强度图像中计算出来的异同位素扩散拉伸来指导上标. 我们基于一个原始配方得出一个数值算法,这种配方是高效地平行的,以多帧每秒运行. 我们显示,这部小说在广泛使用的Middlebury 2007数据集的速度和准确性方面, 提供了明显高于最新艺术水平的样本。 此外,我们引入了具有高度准确的地表真伪的新数据集,首次能够利用真实的传感器数据对深度上下取样方法进行基准测定。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accurate, high resolution depth sensing is a fundamental challenge in computer vision. It is used in a variety of different applications including object reconstruction, robotic navigation and automotive driver assistance. Traditional computer vision approaches calculate the scene depth through computational exhaustive stereo calculations or expensive laser range measurements.
blocks.zh: 准确,高分辨率的深度感知是计算机视觉中的一个基本挑战. 它用于各种不同的应用,包括物体重建,机器人导航和汽车驱动辅助. 传统的计算机视觉方法通过计算详尽无遗的立体计算或昂贵的激光测距来计算场景深度.

blocks.en:
Recently, Time of Flight ( ToF ) range sensors became a popular alternative for dense depth sensing. A per-pixel depth is measured actively through the runtime of light. The measurement is independent from scene texture and largely independent from environmental lighting conditions. It delivers a dense depth map even at very close ranges [ 13 , 21 ] . No additional calculations are necessary, which results in depth measurements at high frame rates.
Recently, ToF sensors have become affordable in the mass market and a small packet size and a low energy consumption make them applicable in mobile devices. However, their main disadvantages are a low resolution caused by chip size limitations and acquisition noise due to limited active illumination energy.
blocks.zh:
最近,飞行时间(ToF)测距传感器成为密集深度感知的流行替代品. 每像素深度通过光的运行时间积极测量. 测量工作独立于场景纹理,基本上独立于环境照明条件. 它在非常近的距离提供密集的深度图[13,21]. 不需要额外计算,这样可以以高帧速率进行深度测量.
近来, 在大众市场上,ToF传感器已变得负担得起,小包大小和低能耗使其适用于移动设备。 然而,它们的主要缺点是芯片尺寸限制和由于活性照明能量有限而获得噪音造成的分辨率低.

blocks.en: We formulate the upsampling as a convex optimization problem [ 3 , 7 ] . The energy is composed of two terms. First, the data term forces the solution to be similar to the input depth measurements. Second, the higher order regularization term enforces a piecewise affine solution, preserving sharp edges according to the texture, while compensating acquisition noise. This term is modeled as a second order Total Generalized Variation ( TGV ) regularization and is weighted according to the intensity image texture by an anisotropic diffusion tensor.

blocks.en:
The main contributions of this work are two-fold: (1) We propose a novel method for fast depth image upsampling by combining a low resolution depth image with high resolution texture information in a variational energy optimization framework. The employed higher order regularization is well suited to model the image acquisition process of modern depth cameras and leads to an improved quality of the upsampled depth maps, compared to state of the art methods.
(2) We propose benchmarking datasets that enable a quantitative comparison of depth image upsampling methods providing real ToF and intensity camera acquisitions together with a highly accurate groundtruth measurement. To encourage further
comparison and future work, these novel datasets and MATLAB code of our method are available at our website 1 1 1 http://rvlab.icg.tugraz.at/tofmark .

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
There are many ways to increase the resolution and the accuracy of depth measurements. In general, they can be separated
in three main classes: (1) fusion of multiple depth sensors, (2) temporal and spatial fusion and (3) upsampling by combining
depth and intensity sensors.
blocks.zh:
提高深度测量的分辨率和准确性有很多方法. 一般来说,它们可以分开
分为三大类:(1) 聚变多深度传感器,(2) 时间和空间聚变,(3) 通过结合进行取样。
深度和强度传感器。

blocks.en:
Recent works addressed the fusion of different depth sensing techniques to increase resolution and quality. Gudmundsson et al . [ 9 ] presented a method for stereo and Time of Flight ( ToF ) depth map fusion in a dynamic programming approach.
Similar work has been proposed by Zhu et al . [ 26 ] using an accurate depth calibration and fusing the
measurements in a Markov Random Field ( MRF ) framework. Additionally to this spatial fusion also a temporal fusion was performed by measuring
the frame-to-frame displacement acquired with high speed intensity cameras.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作涉及将不同的深度感知技术结合起来以提高分辨率和质量。 Gudmundsson et al. [9]在动态编程方法中提出了立体和飞行时间(ToF)深度地图聚变的方法.
朱等人也曾提出类似的工作. [26] 使用精确的深度校准和引信
在Markov Random Field(MRF)框架中进行测量。 除了这种空间聚变之外,还通过测量进行时间聚变。
以高速强度摄像头获得的帧到帧位置。

blocks.en: A common way to improve the resolution and quality of depth information is to fuse multiple depth measurements into one depth map. Schuon et al . [ 22 ] proposed a method to fuse ToF acquisitions of slightly moved viewpoints. It uses a bilateral regularization in a MRF optimization framework incorporating also the ToF sensor characteristics. Based on this work, Cui et al . [ 5 ] used a set of fused depth maps with larger displacements. To create whole volumes of depth data Newcombe et al . [ 15 ] proposed a method for simultaneous camera localization and depth fusion in real time.
blocks.zh: 提高深度信息分辨率和质量的一个共同方法是将多深度测量方法纳入一个深度地图。 Schuon等人[22]提出了一种方法,将略微移动的观点的ToF获取方式融为一体。 它在管理成果框架优化框架中采用双边规范化做法,其中也包含 ToF传感器特性。 基于这项工作,Cui等人[5]使用了一套具有较大迁移量的引信深度图。 为了创造全卷的深度数据Newcombe et al. [15] 提出了实时同步相机定位和深度聚变的方法.

blocks.en: This class of approaches uses additional intensity information as depth cue for image upsampling. Yang et al . [ 24 ] used bilateral filtering of a depth cost volume and a RGB image in an iterative refinement process. Chan et al . [ 4 ] used a noise aware joint bilateral filter to increase the resolution and to reduce depth map errors at multiple frames per second. Diebel and Thrun [ 6 ] performed an upsampling using a MRF formulation, where the smoothness term is weighted according to texture derivatives. A more complex approach was proposed by Park et al . [ 16 ] . They used a combination of different weighting terms of a least squares optimization including segmentation, image gradients, edge saliency and non-local means for depth upsampling. The combination of intensity and depth data in a Bayesian Framework was proposed by Li et al . [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 这一类方法利用额外的强度信息作为图像上标的深度提示。 Yang et al. [24] 在迭代完善过程中,使用了对深度成本量和RGB图像的双边过滤. Chan et al. [4] 使用噪音感知联合双边过滤器增加分辨率,并减少每秒多帧的深度映射误差. Diebel和Thrun [6] 使用MRF配方进行了升标,其光滑度值根据纹理衍生物进行加权. Park等人提出了更为复杂的办法。 他们将最小方形优化的不同加权术语组合起来,包括分化,图像梯度,边缘突出度和非局部手段进行深度向上取样. Li et al.[14] 提出了将强度和深度数据结合到巴耶斯框架的建议。

blocks.en: While the methods for multiple sensor fusion deliver accurate depth results, their quality relies on high calibration effort. Further, most sensor fusion techniques have to calculate a depth map from passive stereo in a preprocessing step before the actual fusion is able to start. Contrary, temporal and spatial fusion approaches rely on multiple acquisitions from a single depth sensor. The major drawback of these methods is that changing environments during these acquisitions will harm the fusion result.
blocks.zh: 虽然多种传感器聚变的方法能提供准确的深度结果,但其质量依赖于高校准努力. 此外,大多数感应聚变技术必须在实际聚变开始前的预处理步骤中从被动立体计算出深度图. 相反,时间和空间聚变方法依赖于从单一深度传感器的多重获取。 这些方法的主要缺点是,在这些收购过程中环境的变化会损害核聚变结果.

blocks.en: To overcome these limitations, we chose the combination of a low resolution depth and a high resolution intensity sensor to increase the natural depth sensor resolution. The upsampling is calculated on a per image basis without the need for complex preprocessing. Existing approaches, such as [ 4 , 24 ] , calculate this depth upsampling by a bilateral filtering. While bilateral filtering techniques can operate at high frame rates they have a drawback in oversmoothing fine details. In contrast, our method builds on the success of recently introduced upsampling methods using MRF and least squares optimization [ 6 , 16 ] . Unlike them, our approach incorporates a higher order regularization, which avoids surface flattening. Furthermore, we use an anisotropic diffusion tensor based on the intensity image. This tensor not only weights the depth gradient but also orients the gradient direction during the optimization process.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们选择了低分辨率深度和高分辨率强度传感器的组合,以提高自然深度传感器的分辨率. 上采样按每个图像计算,不需要复杂的预处理. 现有办法,如[4,24],通过双边过滤计算出这种深度上升。 虽然双边过滤技术可以以高帧率运行,但是在过于舒畅的精细细节方面有缺点。 与此相反,我们的方法建立在最近采用利用管理成果框架和最小方程优化的抽样方法的成功基础上。 与它们不同的是,我们的方法包含了更高的秩序正规化,避免表面平坦. 此外,我们使用基于强度图像的异同位素扩散拉伸。 这个变压器不仅能加权深度梯度,而且还能指示优化过程中的梯度方向.

blocks.en: Our upsampling method increases the resolution of measured depth data from a low resolution depth sensor by adding edge cues from a high resolution intensity image. To be able to use both information, we map the depth measurements to the intensity camera coordinate system as described in Section 3.1 . With this mapping we get a depth map D S D_{\mathrm{S}} of a sparse set of base depth measurements from the low resolution depth sensor.

The regularization term has to meet the challenges of producing a high resolution depth map out of a sparse set of depth points. In this section, we show a quantitative and qualitative evaluation of our upsampling method.
For an extensive evaluation we investigate the performance compared to state of the art approaches on the simulated Middlebury 2007 datasets [ 11 , 20 ] in terms of speed and accuracy.
Beyond this simulations, we evaluate our method on real data with highly accurate groundtruth measurements. In our experiments we use a 2 × 2 2\times 2 gradient operator to calculate the intensity image gradients. The tensor parameters β \beta and γ \gamma as well as the TGV parameters α 0 \alpha_{0} and α 1 \alpha_{1} are manually set once for each upsampling factor and are constant in synthetic and the real world evaluations.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们对我们的抽样方法进行了定量和定性评估。
为了进行广泛的评估,我们从速度和准确性的角度,对模拟的Middlebury 2007数据集[11,20]上与最新技术方法相比的性能进行了调查。
除了模拟外,我们用非常精确的地面真实测量来评估我们的方法。 在我们的实验中,我们使用一个2×2 2\time 2梯度操作符来计算强度图像梯度. 热量参数β\β和γ\γ以及TGV参数α 0\α_{0}和α 1\α_{1}为每个增生因子手动设置一次,在合成和真实世界评价中是恒定的.

blocks.en: 4.1 Middlebury Benchmark Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 米德尔伯里基准评价

blocks.en:
An exhaustive evaluation of our method in terms of quantitative and qualitative comparison is made using input images from the Middlebury datasets [ 11 , 20 ] . We use the disparity image as groundtruth and the original RGB intensity image as input for our anisotropic diffusion tensor. Park et al . [ 16 ] provides low resolution input depth images with different downsampling factors ( × 2 \times 2 , × 4 \times 4 , × 8 \times 8 , × 16 \times 16 ). To simulate the acquisition process, these input images contain additional Gaussian noise with a standard deviation that increases with the disparity. Using these datasets we are able to compare our results with the Markov Random Field ( MRF ) based approach of Diebel and Thrun [ 6 ] , the bilateral filtering with cost volume refinement of Yang et al . [ 24 ] , the guided image filtering approach of He et al . [ 10 ] , the noise-aware bilateral filter approach by Chan et al . [ 4 ] and the non-local means filtering by Park et al . [ 16 ] .
Further, we compare the results to common interpolation methods.
The confidence measure w w in our functional is set to 1 1 for all depth points. The parameters α 0 \alpha_{0} and α 1 \alpha_{1} have been kept fixed for all datasets and have been empirically chosen for × 2 \times 2 / × 4 \times 4 / × 8 \times 8 / × 16 \times 16 as 0.154 0.154 , 0.023 0.023 / 0.05 0.05 , 0.0056 0.0056 / 0.267 0.267 , 0.03 0.03 / 0.267 0.267 , 0.03 0.03 .

The numerical results for this experiment in terms of the root mean squared error ( RMSE ) and computation time are shown in Table 1 . blocks.en: What can be clearly seen is that our method delivers an upsampling quality that is superior compared to state of the art methods at a lower computation time. This quality improvement originates from a Total Generalized Variation ( TGV ) regularization combined with an anisotropic diffusion tensor. The higher order regularization better captures the surface of real world scenes, while the anisotropic diffusion tensor delivers a more defined guidance of the high resolution intensity data compared to a simple scalar weighting.
blocks.zh: 可以清楚地看到,我们的方法在较低的计算时间提供了比最新技术方法更高的质量。 这种质量的提高源于全面通用变异(TGV)的正规化,加上异同位素扩散的拉伸。 更高顺序的规范化能更好地捕捉真实世界场景的表面,而异位扩散的拉伸则能提供比简单的标尺加权更明确的高分辨率数据指导.

blocks.en: While the Middlebury datasets are popular to evaluate depth upsampling methods, they neglect some important properties of real acquisition setups. Typically, depth and intensity data do not originate from the same sensor and are therefore not aligned. Further, real low resolution depth sensors measure depth data with a more complex acquisition noise which can not be simulated by adding simple Gaussian noise. Therefore, we create a novel benchmarking dataset based on real sensor data.
blocks.zh: 虽然Middlebury数据集很受欢迎,用来评价深度提升抽样方法,但它们忽略了真实获取设置的一些重要属性. 通常情况下,深度和强度数据并不来自同一传感器,因此不匹配。 此外,真正的低分辨率深度传感器用更复杂的获取噪声测量深度数据,这些噪声不能通过添加简单的高斯噪声来模拟。 因此,我们根据真实的传感器数据创建了一套新的基准数据集。

blocks.en: 4.2 Benchmarking based on Real Sensor Data
blocks.zh: 4.2 根据真实传感器数据制定基准

blocks.en: The evaluation on real acquisitions is made using different scenes acquired with a Time of Flight ( ToF ) and an intensity camera simultaneously. For depth measurements we use a PMD Nano ToF camera delivering a 120 × 160 120\times 160 dense depth and IR amplitude image [ 2 ] . The intensity image is acquired by a CMOS camera with a sensor size of 810 × 610 810\times 610 pixel.

Calibration of the intensity camera and the ToF camera is a crucial part in our upsampling system since the quality of the calibration directly affects the accuracy of the upsampling result.
The intrinsic and extrinsic camera parameters are calibrated similar to the method of Zhang [ 25 ] . A planar target with circular feature points and known geometry is acquired from different viewpoints. Through the known correspondence between the feature points on the target plane and in the image, focal length, principal point and radial and tangential distortions are estimated. To calibrate the intrinsic parameters of the ToF camera, the low resolution IR amplitude image I L : Ω L ⊆ ℝ 2 I_{\mathrm{L}}\colon\Omega_{\mathrm{L}}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{2} is used.
The rotation and translation between intensity and ToF camera is estimated by establishing a geometric correspondence through the feature points on the planar target.

The groundtruth measurements are generated using a structured light scanner which consists of two 2048 × 2048 2048\times 2048 pixel high-speed intensity cameras and one high-speed projector. The depth uncertainty at the given baseline is 1.2 ​ mm 1.2\mathrm{mm} . To get a dense depth map, multiple acquisitions with slightly displaced projection angles are fused together.
The acquired scenes are chosen to incorporate structures with high texture variations (see Books scene) as well as thin wiry elements ( Shark and Devil scenes) to evaluate the upsampling accuracy. All scenes lie in the depth range of 0.8 − 1.2 ​ m 0.8-1.2\mathrm{m} which reflects the operation distance of modern ToF cameras.

blocks.en: One issue that occurs in real world datasets is that wrong ToF measurements result in displaced surfaces in the upsampled result. Another problem arises due to the difference in the viewpoint of the observing cameras. Thus, the projected depth measurements near large depth steps can differ from correct depth values. Because the distance between the cameras is very small compared to the measured depth range, these wrong measurements have no large impact on the result and can be handled by the regularization term. Despite that, in the visual and numerical results it can be seen that our method delivers high quality upsampling results at multiple frames per second for an approximate upsampling factor of × 6.25 \times 6.25 . Through the additional incorporation of the ToF sensor characteristics into our optimization, the acquisition noise is drastically reduced, while sharp edges and smooth surfaces are preserved. Compared to other methods it delivers superior results. Comparison to more state of the art methods was not possible due to the lack of publicly available implementations, yet we provide a benchmarking framework to help others in benchmarking their methods.
blocks.zh: 在现实世界数据集中发生的一个问题是,错误的 ToF 测量结果导致检测结果中的表层迁移. 另一个问题是观测摄像头观点的不同。 因此,大深度步骤附近的预测深度测量可能不同于正确的深度值. 由于相机之间的距离与测量的深度范围相比非常小,这些错误的测量对结果没有太大影响,可以通过规范化术语来处理. 尽管如此,在视觉和数字结果中可以看到,我们的方法以每秒多帧的速度提供质量高的抽样结果,大约为×6.25\时。 6.25 (英语). 通过将ToF传感器特性进一步纳入我们的优化,获取噪音被大幅降低,同时锋利的边缘和光滑的表面得到保存. 与其他方法相比,它能提供优异的结果。 由于缺乏可公开获得的执行,无法与更多最新技术方法进行比较,但我们提供了一个基准框架,帮助其他国家制定方法的基准。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper we propose a novel method for depth map upsampling using a low resolution, low cost 3D sensor and an additional high resolution 2D sensor. The upsampling is formulated as a global energy optimization problem using Total Generalized Variation ( TGV ) regularization. For fast numerical optimization we use a first order primal-dual algorithm, which is efficiently parallelized resulting in high frame rates. In a quantitative evaluation using widespread datasets we show that our method clearly outperforms existing state of the art methods in terms of speed and quality. We further provide benchmarking datasets of real world scenes providing a highly accurate groundtruth that, for the first time, enable a real quality comparison of depth image upsampling methods. On these datasets we show a visual as well as numerical evaluation of our method.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出一种使用低分辨率,低成本的3D传感器和额外的高分辨率2D传感器进行深度映射提升的新方法. 采用通用总变异(TGV)规范化方法,将提高采样定为全球能源优化问题。 为了快速的数值优化,我们使用第一顺序的初选二进制算法,这种算法是高效平行的,导致帧率高. 在利用广泛的数据集进行的定量评估中,我们显示,在速度和质量方面,我们的方法明显超越了现有的技术水平。 我们还提供了真实世界场景的基准数据集,提供了高度准确的地面真实性,首次能够对深度图像取样方法进行真正的质量比较。 在这些数据集上,我们显示了对我们方法的视觉和数字评价。

blocks.en: The proposed method is not limited to single image upsampling. As a future perspective, it will be extended to incorporate a temporal coherence in a consistent way, eventually leading to depth reconstructions with even higher accuracy.
blocks.zh: 拟议的方法不仅限于单一的图像提升样本. 作为未来的视角,它将扩大范围,以一致的方式纳入时间上的一致性,最终导致更准确的深度重建。
